scope: basic explicit Japanese prohibition boundaries joined across whole shaping clusters, three-pass native offscreen composition and diagnostic archive retirement

limits: Fonts are immutable Flash fixture inputs; no native SD/VFS font reads
Four matrix and five bounded text jobs share one live task; no service restart
Stack watermark and trap samples are observations, not arbitrary-font or IO call-chain upper bounds

policy.profile: basic explicit noEnd/noStart scalar sets; not JIS/JLREQ/UAX14 conformance
policy.source_map_bytes: UTF-8 input bytes plus one endpoint; caller-owned output, no internal allocation
policy.native_source_mode: comptime canonical input maps; dynamic arbitrary source preparation host-tested only
policy.readonly_map_placement: existing loader-mapped .flash.rodata.display; all executable kernel/task/interrupt/allocator code remains SRAM
policy.negative_control: same-geometry independent host composition, policy disabled; two prohibited starts, repaired by legal spans
policy.opening_bracket_and_multi_glyph: host synthetic evidence only; pinned native cases do not test opening-bracket or multi-glyph-cluster behavior
policy.no_emergency_break: oversized joined span or full box returns typed error without cursor mutation

memory.combined_peak: not measured; separately observed font/raster/canvas peaks are not a simultaneous peak
memory.floor_policy: unchanged 48 KiB; device profile reaches that floor exactly; future features need a placement/budget decision

device.evidence: structural image audit only; no hardware access

failed_attempts.description: Initial safe links exceeded 48 KiB floor; a later indexed-map prototype linked but audit rejected non-ASCII symbol names caused by source-text generic arguments. Neither attempt is qualified. Numeric case IDs fix symbols; checks/floor are not relaxed.
failed_attempts.source_limit: initial link archive preserves representative edited source files and its error log, not a complete candidate source snapshot; no successful runtime claim

validation.host_unit_tests: zig build test passed, including basic prohibited edges, negative control, vertical continuation, multi-glyph cluster, oversized chain, invalid UTF-8/byte offsets, capacity and alias preservation
validation.tool_unit_tests: 181 passed, including reference opening-bracket control and typed native policy/archive evidence negative controls
validation.native_execution: full P4 native emulator smoke passed; all three prohibition hashes match independent batch/per-source-pixel reference; all prior unwrapped and cluster-only hashes remain unchanged
validation.static_analysis: Zig format/ZLint, shellcheck, 21 architecture tests and six default native ELF audits passed
validation.preview_review: visually inspected host horizontal/vertical prohibition previews; body punctuation stays with preceding base; ruby remains independent

limits: Fonts are immutable Flash fixture inputs; no native SD/VFS font reads
Four matrix and five bounded text jobs share one live task; no service restart
Stack watermark and trap samples are observations, not arbitrary-font or IO call-chain upper bounds
Basic explicit character set only; no full JLREQ/JIS/UAX14 claim, hyphen/ellipsis inseparability, western words, hanging punctuation, or justification
Caller starts span adapter at a shaping-cluster head; source maps and text revision must match glyph byte offsets
No automatic ruby-base association/distribution across lines, bidi/contextual reshaping, paragraph pagination or native dynamic text-to-map path
Paragraph edges are forced boundaries; preexisting prohibited marks at fragment endpoints are preserved
Host PNGs and native offscreen hashes are not LCD/cache/DMA or physical Tab5 evidence
Font-stack/library SRAM remains reserved while idle; no new quota, fixed stack or primary region enlargement
No hardware write, remote push, main integration or firmware publication
